articleTitle: Acupuncture and Tuina Combined with Educational Rehabilitation for Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder: Study Protocol for a Single-Center, Three-Arm, Pragmatic Randomized Controlled Trial.
takeaways: This is a study protocol only - no actual results or findings are available yet as the research has not been conducted
The study will test whether adding acupuncture and tuina massage to standard educational therapy improves outcomes for children with autism spectrum disorder
Three treatment groups will be compared: educational rehabilitation alone, educational rehabilitation plus acupuncture, and educational rehabilitation plus tuina massage
The research is being conducted in China where Traditional Chinese Medicine approaches are commonly used alongside conventional autism treatments
Results from this pragmatic randomized controlled trial will provide evidence on whether these complementary therapies offer measurable benefits when added to standard care
